title: Sign-in is now Discord only
text: Accounts are now created and signed in only with Discord. The old password sign-in is turned off, so nobody can create accounts or guess passwords without Discord. The Change password button is gone from Settings because it is no longer needed. If you already play, nothing changes for you.

title: Game updates in Discord
text: From now on every game update is posted in Logs and in the #updates channel of our Discord server.

title: Smoother loading and editor tool names
text:
- On school and office networks the game could hang on "Loading map..." forever. It now switches to a backup connection after a few seconds and remembers it for that network.
- Hovering any tool in the map editor now shows its name. Before, the names were cut off by the tool panel.
- The Hide and Seek page now explains the current rules: in Classic a caught player turns orange and is out of the round, in Zombie Apocalypse they become a zombie and join the hunt.

title: Discord bot
text:
- Our Discord server now has its own bot.
- Every game update is posted in the updates channel.
- The bot removes spam, scams, adult content and insults automatically. Breaking the rules first gives a warning, then short mutes; bans are only for repeated serious cases.
